title: Agents get thirty days to conform to new specifications before Core GovOps can rewrite their Artifacts without a vote
content:
A.1.14.2.11 addresses what happens when the Sky Core Atlas changes the specifications Agent Artifacts must satisfy. A.1.14.2.11.1 offers two routes and makes the Agent-led one the default: if Core GovOps chooses to act directly "it must communicate this directly to the affected Agents before submitting an Atlas Edit Proposal. Otherwise the process for changes carried out by Agents applies."

Under A.1.14.2.11.1.1, each Agent "must update their Agent Artifact through the appropriate governance process to conform to the new specifications" and "must carry out these changes within thirty (30) days of the change in specifications in the Atlas unless otherwise specified by Core GovOps."

A.1.14.2.11.1.2 is the override, and its second sentence is the load-bearing one: Core GovOps "may submit an Atlas Edit Proposal to directly update each Agent Artifact to conform to the change in specifications. Such an edit **may directly modify Agent Artifacts and is not subject to further approval by Agent token holders**." The only softener is that Core GovOps "should communicate the anticipated timing... as early as practicable" — a should, not a must.

The justification is coherent: conformance edits are mechanical, they implement a decision SKY holders already made, and requiring hundreds of separate Agent votes to ratify a change none of them can refuse would be pure ceremony with an indefinite tail of non-conforming Artifacts.

But the boundary is thin and unpoliced by this Section. What counts as "conforming to a specification" versus substantively rewriting an Agent's governance is a judgment made by Core GovOps, exercisable without the affected token holders' consent. The protection is not procedural but doctrinal — A.1.14.1.6.3's requirement that root-level intervention be "proportionate and limited" and consistent with the Spirit of the Atlas.
description: Core GovOps may instead choose to propagate a Sky Core Atlas specification change itself, by an Atlas Edit that modifies Agent Artifacts and is not subject to Agent token holder approval.
